preconditions: Power-up and wait 15ms before SMBus communication

steps.notes: Wait 15ms after power-up before first SMBus access
Set Configuration register to default (0x00): active mode, ALERT interrupt mode, default range, dynamic averaging enabled
Set conversion rate to 4 conversions per second (default)
Set pointer to 0x00 (Internal Diode High Byte), then read 1 byte (high byte)
Set pointer to 0x29 (Internal Diode Low Byte), then read 1 byte (low byte)

operation_flows.notes: The read flow does not include a wait or poll for conversion completion. At default 4 conversions/sec, data may be up to 250ms old. Consider polling BUSY bit or adding a delay.

steps.notes: Set pointer to 0x01 (External Diode 1 High Byte), then read 1 byte
Set pointer to 0x10 (External Diode 1 Low Byte), then read 1 byte

operation_flows.notes: The read flow does not include a wait or poll for conversion completion. At default 4 conversions/sec, data may be up to 250ms old. Consider polling BUSY bit or adding a delay.

steps.notes: Set pointer to 0x23 (External Diode 2 High Byte), then read 2 bytes (high byte then low byte)

operation_flows.notes: The read flow does not include a wait or poll for conversion completion. At default 4 conversions/sec, data may be up to 250ms old. Consider polling BUSY bit or adding a delay.

steps.notes: Write any value to One Shot register (0x0F) to initiate a single conversion cycle
Wait for conversion to complete (max conversion time ~250ms at 1/16 sec rate)

raw_encoding.notes: Temperature data: 11-bit unsigned in default range (0 to 127.875°C). High byte bits 7-0 are integer part, low byte bits 7-5 are fractional (0.5, 0.25, 0.125). Lower 5 bits of low byte are zero.

init_sequence.notes: Wait 15ms after power-up before first SMBus communication.
Write Configuration register (0x03) with 0x00: active mode, ALERT interrupt mode, default range, dynamic averaging enabled.
Write Conversion Rate register (0x04) with 0x06: 4 conversions per second (default).

read_sequence.notes: Set pointer to 0x00 (Internal Diode High Byte), then read 1 byte.
Set pointer to 0x29 (Internal Diode Low Byte), then read 1 byte.

timing_constraints.name: power_up_smbus_delay
timing_constraints.notes: For the first 15ms after power-up the device may not respond to SMBus communications.

timing_constraints.name: conversion_period
timing_constraints.notes: Default conversion rate is 4 conversions per second, so period is 250ms.

conversion_formulae.name: temperature_from_raw
conversion_formulae.formula: Temperature (°C) = raw_11bit * 0.125, where raw_11bit is the 11-bit unsigned value from high byte (bits 7-0) and low byte bits 7-5 (fractional 0.5, 0.25, 0.125). In default range, values <0°C are reported as 0°C; values >127.875°C are clamped to 127.875°C.

inputs.name: high_byte
inputs.description: High byte of temperature data (integer part)

inputs.name: low_byte
inputs.description: Low byte of temperature data (fractional part in bits 7-5)

evidence_spans.snippet: The EMC1413-A and EMC1414-A SMBus slave address is determined by the pull-up resistor on the THERM pin as shown in Table 5.1
For the first 15ms after power-up the device may not respond to SMBus communications.
all temperatures are stored as an 11-bit value with the high byte representing the integer value and the low byte representing the fractional value left justified to occupy the MSBits.
The default range is from 0°C to +127°C and the temperature is represented as binary number able to report a temperature from 0°C to +127.875°C in 0.125°C steps.
The Configuration Register controls the basic operation of the device.
The Conversion Rate Register controls how often the temperature measurement channels are updated and compared against the limits.

requires_human: The default address is ambiguous: Table 5.1 lists multiple addresses based on pull-up resistor. The 10k resistor address (0x4C) is chosen as default because it is the most common value, but the datasheet does not explicitly label any as default. Confirm which address to use as default.

The extended temperature range (-64°C to 191°C) is available but not used in the default configuration. If needed, the RANGE bit in Configuration register must be set and limit registers must be programmed accordingly. This extraction assumes default range.
Dynamic averaging is enabled by default (DAVG_DIS=0). If disabled, conversion timing and current consumption change. This extraction assumes default enabled.
The Beta Compensation and Ideality Factor registers are left at default values. For specific diodes, these may need adjustment per datasheet tables.

The read flow for internal temperature and external diode 1 does not include a wait or poll for conversion completion. At default 4 conversions/sec, data may be up to 250ms old. Consider polling BUSY bit or adding a delay.

The internal temperature low byte is at register 0x29, not contiguous after 0x00. The current flow reads 2 bytes from 0x00, which would read 0x00 and 0x01 (External Diode 1 High Byte). This is incorrect. The correct method is to read each byte separately or use a block read if supported. Datasheet does not specify block read behavior.
External Diode 1 low byte is at 0x10, not contiguous after 0x01. Current flow reads 2 bytes from 0x01, which would read 0x01 and 0x02 (Status). This is incorrect. Need separate reads or block read.
